title: Storage Archive Operations PRO UX, Durable History Lifecycle, Recovery Fairness and Integrity Closeout
summary: Completes the accepted Stage 13.5 / 4.10.5 technical scope with a unified PRO archive-operations experience and durable backend lifecycle truth. Storage operations now expose bounded, localized status and history while archive integrity plans, operations and audit evidence retain safe foreign-key lifecycles, deterministic retirement and crash-safe replay. Legacy exact unbound operations are discovered without duplicate work, fair bounded recovery prevents malformed candidates from starving valid plans, and final claim/reclaim expiry gates block destructive execution before binding without mutating files. The closeout also preserves truthful active-owner fencing, complete large-directory and multi-root evidence, and executable operator next actions.
changelog: Replaces the storage operations panel with a unified localized PRO archive-management workflow.
Adds durable bounded status and history for retention, integrity, migration and root lifecycle actions.
Introduces schema version 7 lifecycle constraints for storage operations, integrity plans, items and audit evidence.
Preserves operation and integrity history through explicit foreign-key ownership, retirement and bounded cleanup rules.
Retires expired never-applied integrity plans safely under concurrent worker and API activity.
Keeps soft-deleted cameras with retained archive data inside integrity scans until catalog retirement is final.
Makes integrity findings deterministic so one trusted object has one authoritative active category.
Recovers physical remediation truth without repeating delete, quarantine, metadata mutation or mandatory audit writes.
Discovers exact legacy unbound apply operations with null domain references without creating duplicate operations.
Uses bounded keyset recovery so rejected candidates cannot starve later valid integrity work.
Stops recovery on unknown database or session failures without advancing beyond uncertain candidates.
Revalidates plan expiry after durable claim or reclaim and before the first destructive running binding.
Preserves live foreign operation ownership and fails closed when exact ownership or identity cannot be proven.
Keeps operator-visible retry, conflict and next-action guidance tied to executable backend capabilities.
